target: Improve the frozen v1 hybrid against adaptive, previously unseen opponents while retaining its advantage over W-tap in MMC sumo. Elite human play is sealed; it is the final target.
algorithms: Compare a feedforward stochastic policy trained by clipped on-policy actor-critic updates against populations trained with evolutionary self-play. All competitive outputs still become ordinary physical input heads. The deterministic exported policy is tested in Minecraft. Learn against the initial four architectures, two targeted adversaries, previous champions, timing/strafe specialists, W-tap, Hold-W, trade and pressure.
distribution: Use only the original 16 training donors. Include 0/0 and 80/80 ms regulation play. Randomize a declared subset of training starts across asymmetric latency, opening distances, disk sizes and sideways offsets. Report regulation and shifted starts separately. No claim that these development variations are independent native timing donors or that they match the real elite-player distribution.
objective: Win the ring-out, draw half credit. For model selection group opponents into scripted basics, movement and timing specialists, the four v1 architectures, the targeted exploiters and newer self-play rivals. Rank by 60% average group score plus 40% worst group score. Use the eight old development selection clocks to screen, then a full finalist cross-play. Keep W-tap, Hold-W, frozen hybrid and the best exploiter in comparisons.
sealing: Freeze the overall challenger before collecting the next eight native mirror donors with prefix elite-robust-sealed. Do not choose an alternate winner after validation. Test transfer in balanced native MMC sumo against W-tap, Hold-W, the frozen hybrid, both trained adversaries and lateral hit selectors. Include asymmetric latency and a separate Hypixel-like stress test. Human evaluation remains prospective.
compute: Sequential heavy JVMs with bounded workers. Keep capacity for the main lab and capture scoring. Save intermediate checkpoints for reproducibility.
